images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a premium MMORPG weapon concept sheet for the noble Blue Moon Twilight collection. Create ONE landscape 3:2 image, 1536x1024, containing EXACTLY THREE DIFFERENT BOWS only. Do not repeat skinny filigree scrolls, dangly jewelry, strings of beads or lots of tiny spikes. Show refined playable fantasy weapons with readable construction, crisp premium concept-render detail and controlled glow, not flat icons. No staffs, swords, arrows, characters, hands, stands, captions, letters, labels, watermark, panels or background moon. Each of the three designs must be clearly different in limb geometry and moon placement, not a recolor or mirrored copy. LEFT: an asymmetrical bow whose broad upper limb forms a single monumental inward-facing blue crescent, its lower limb a narrow long cobalt sabre curve. MIDDLE: a compact recurved bow with a thick luminous crescent open to the left wrapping OUTSIDE the central grip, two short angular midnight-blue horn limbs. RIGHT: a tall off-center C-shaped bow with a very broad crescent lower limb and an open hooked upper limb sweeping forward; the dominant blue crescent is below the grip.
